workflow_metadata.name: Dev-01 Initialization & Environment Bootstrap
workflow_metadata.description: Establish reproducible development environment per build_ready_index and capture mission artifacts.

language_configuration_validation.description: Development language configuration must be present and valid
language_configuration_validation.validation: All services must have language and framework assignments

steps.validation: Language configuration must exist before development begins

steps.description: Parse build_ready_index.json to enumerate dependency layers
Validate required runtimes, toolchains, lint/test frameworks for selected languages
steps.validation: All required language runtimes and tools must be available

steps.description: Generate interface contracts based on development standards

behavior.fallback: If standards file not found, use 'protocol_di' as default
behavior.no_user_prompt: Choice already made during S-03-A07 - uses stored preference

steps.previous_version_note: v3.18.0 prompted user here; v3.20.0 reads from development_standards.json configured during setup

outputs: services/common/mixins/*.py (Behavior mixins: HasLifecycle, HasLogging, RequiresAuth, TracksMetrics)
if_choice_1_protocol_based.purpose: Generate Protocol-based interfaces with dependency injection infrastructure
benefits: No metaclass conflicts with frameworks (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic)
Behavior mixins for code reuse (wide inheritance pattern)
next_steps: 2. Update services/common/di/container.py with your service implementations
3. Implement services using Protocols and mixins

if_choice_2_abc_based.purpose: Generate Abstract Base Class interfaces for compile-time/runtime validation
usage: Provider services: Implement the interface (class MyService(ProviderInterface))
Consumer services: Import the interface for type hints
Tests: Mock using the interface for contract testing
limitations: All implementations must inherit from ABC

if_choice_3_skip.recommendation: Not recommended - interface generation provides type safety and documentation
